subject: Capacity bridge & tier regrade — onboarding and legal timeline
messages:
From: Tom Chen <tom.chen@palletly.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API commit increase — initial ask

Hey Mina,

Quick note from our side after this week's load testing: we expect a sustained 2.5x on monthly token usage starting September (mostly inference for order routing). Can we discuss converting our current burst-heavy plan to a higher monthly commit with a short bridge period? Ideally we'd do a 3-month bridge while legal and procurement finish the final SOW.

Key asks:
- Target committed monthly tokens: ~1.1B
- Short bridge capacity for August/Sept while SOW finalized
- Any changes to rate limits or soft throttle behavior we should expect?

I'm looping in contracts@palletly.com (for timing) but happy to coordinate with your CS/ops.

Thanks,
Tom Chen
Head of Platform — Palletly

[attachment: load-test-summary-aug12.csv (csv)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@palletly.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit increase — initial ask

Thanks Tom — really helpful data. Short answer: yes, we can do a staged commit upgrade with a bridge period.

Proposed approach:
1) Immediate: enable a temporary capacity bridge for Aug 20 — Sep 30 to cover the 2.5x spike. This is a one-time, prorated add-on (we'll include burst credits for the period).
2) Committed change: move to 1.1B monthly tokens starting Oct 1 on a 12-mo term (you'll get a discounted per-token rate vs current hosted rates).
3) Rate limits: default per-route QPS will remain the same; we will provision additional concurrency for your API key and enable a higher soft-throttle threshold during the bridge.
4) Ops handoff: karthik will prepare an onboarding runbook (KV cache priming, suggested batching/quantization profile) to reduce unit cost.

Attachments: draft SOW (Palletly_SOW_v2.pdf) and initial onboarding runbook (onboarding_runbook.md). Please flag any redlines you need in the SOW.

Next steps / timeline:
- Today: we enable an interim bridge ticket for Aug 20 (ops provisioning)
- Mon Aug 17: legal sends SOW redlines (DocuSign link to follow)
- Sep 30: bridge ends; new committed plan goes live Oct 1

Laura — can you confirm pricing cadence and whether we need PO/invoice timing details from Tom?

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

[attachment: Palletly_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)] [attachment: onboarding_runbook.md (text)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Chen <tom.chen@palletly.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 13:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit increase — pricing & procurement

Tom / Mina —

Thanks for the context. Pricing summary for the proposed 1.1B monthly commit (12-month term):
- Committed unit price: $0.0000125 per token (applies to committed usage)
- Bridge add-on: prorated charge for Aug 20—Sep 30 at $0.000016 per token for overage beyond your current commit
- Billing cadence: monthly invoice in arrears; we can accept PO on file for the term.

Procurement note: we'll publish the final SOW to DocuSign once we have any legal redlines addressed. For timing, if contracts@palletly.com can return the signed SOW by Aug 25 we can ensure the committed plan starts Oct 1 and the bridge covers the interim dates.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 — I've updated the renewal opportunity with the proposed rates and committed start date.

Karthik — please confirm ops readiness for an Aug 20 bridge spin-up and let me know if we need any extra lead time.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference

From: Tom Chen <tom.chen@palletly.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@palletly.com, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit increase — pricing & procurement

Mina / Laura — thanks, that all looks reasonable. A couple quick items: 

- We'll aim to return signed SOW by Aug 24 (contracts team is on it).
- For invoicing: can you send the first invoice on Oct 1 for the committed plan (we prefer month-in-advance for budgeting) — if that's not possible, we can accept the standard monthly in-arrears invoice but wanted to flag preference.
- Can your ops team confirm any temporary endpoint name changes or API key rotations required during the bridge? We want to avoid re-deploying clients mid-bridge.

Forwarding your email thread to our contracts mailbox for tracking.

Thanks,
Tom
Head of Platform — Palletly
